title: Siege on the Dragon Cult
description: Captain Valmir requests help retrieving the mask of the Dragon Priest Rahgot from the ruins of Forelhost, the last stronghold of the Dragon Cult. After the mask is recovered, Valmir is revealed as an impostor tricking soldiers into the ruins for his own purposes.

base_facts: I am a military officer sent to recover a powerful artifact from Forelhost.
The Dragon Cult made their last stand at Forelhost in the First Era.
The commander's mask is an extremely powerful artifact.
A general who stormed the fortress left a journal that might help navigate the collapsed areas.

VALMIR_BETRAYAL: I am an impostor who has been tricking soldiers into the ruins to retrieve the mask for my true masters.
My orders direct me to return the mask to Labyrinthian.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My imposture has been exposed and I have been killed on the battlements of Forelhost.
My orders revealed I was an agent—likely Thalmor—sent to retrieve the mask and deliver it to Labyrinthian, presumably to Bromjunaar Sanctuary.
I was recruiting soldiers from both sides of the civil war to retrieve the mask for my true masters.

base_facts: I am the Dragon Priest who commanded the last stronghold of the Dragon Cult at Forelhost.
My followers chose death over surrender when the fortress was stormed in the First Era.

QUEST_COMPLETE: I have been slain and my mask claimed from my remains.
My body also yielded a dragon priest staff and the key to the battlements.
A word of power for the Storm Call shout can be learned from the word wall upon my battlements.

beats.comment: Player accepts Valmir's request to enter Forelhost and retrieve Rahgot's mask.
Player finds Skorm Snow-Strider's journal revealing how the cultists sealed themselves in and the well was poisoned.
Player defeats the Dragon Priest Rahgot and claims his mask.
Valmir is exposed as an impostor caught recruiting another soldier while wearing opposing faction armor.
Quest concludes after the impostor Valmir is defeated.
